phase: Round 1 implementation: exact terrain physics, 30 FPS fixed-step integrity, player-relative rain, brighter route/terrain separation, and a batched storm-harvester landmark kit. Fresh capture and blind visual scoring remain required; do not declare AAA yet.
bar: Tribes: Ascend Katabatic and Arx Novena set macro-flow, terrain silhouette, route-conversion, and 900 m-scale expectations. Warsow WCA1/wdm5 set micro-route, combat-space, and high-contrast traversal readability expectations. Modern asset fidelity is judged separately with the installed Three.js AAA visual scorecard.

tests.playwright: 11 focused checks green; 1 skipped; 1 transient asset-fetch retry pending
tests.note: 24,000-triangle height/normal parity is exact. Four ski lanes, downhill retention, southwest race launch, bunker release, and authored lighting pass. Fog values passed but its first page emitted a transient sky fetch error; retry pending.

pieces.name: Playable bounds (2×)
pieces.gap: 960×800 m is in the Katabatic-scale envelope; the remaining question is density and decision frequency, tracked separately.

log.text: World scale landed: Monsoon 960×800, QuickSense 720×640, fog/camera/shadow far planes stretched.
Star Sparrow flight box expanded to ±356 × ±316 to match the 720×640 playable half-extents.

pieces.name: Rendered / gameplay surface parity
pieces.gap: None in the deterministic terrain test: gameplay height and normal now sample the exact rendered triangle.

rounds.evidence: All 24,000 triangles sampled internally: max height error <0.1 mm and minimum normal dot >0.99999.

log.text: Found mean analytic/mesh discrepancy 0.243 m and max 5.03 m.
Made the O(1) piecewise-triangle height/normal sampler authoritative for support, props, routes, and collision-derived decisions.

pieces.name: Ski lines vs Katabatic / WCA1
pieces.gap: Four broad lanes and downhill retention pass, but a clean-context play critic still needs to judge route choices and encounter frequency.

rounds.evidence: Four-lane flow and continuous downhill-retention Playwright checks pass against the corrected triangle surface.

log.text: Raised the 120 Hz catch-up cap from two to four steps so the documented 30 FPS floor no longer advances at half speed.

pieces.name: Launch ramps and committed downhill
pieces.gap: Southwest race launch passes speed retention, lip crossing, climb, and airtime after compacting its long uphill spend. Blind feel review remains.

rounds.evidence: Southwest concrete launch traverses at race speed and produces sustained airtime on the exact rendered surface.

log.text: Jump-pad test now stands on live pad world positions. Flat-ground pads were launching then losing vertical speed on the next walk-move frame — unground on trigger.
QuickSense pad shells were scaling with the arena (12.4 m diameter). Counter-scaled like the outpost so they stay Warsow-sized.
Fighter roots were 2.8 m under the raised tower deck; hull hit the underside after ~0.7 m of lift. Pads now sample live deck Y + housing offset. Takeoff test green.

pieces.name: Visual density at 2×
pieces.gap: Baseline fails for primitive slabs and sparse hierarchy. A <=6-draw-call storm-harvester, basalt-spine, and route-beacon kit is being integrated before recapture.

log.text: Outpost east stair landings were missing from the smooth-support chain; the climb seeker fell through a 0.4 m gap at stair 2. Landings added. Full terrain-to-interior climb green.
